recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change the current Medication resource for FHIR-8066; any future cleanup of the unreferenced historical value set file or binding registry should be handled as a separate terminology/build-scope task.
issue_request: FHIR-8066 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy correction for DSTU1 Medication.package.container. It reported that the binding or link pointed to route-of-administration value set contents and requested the correct package-form value set contents, specifically SNOMED CT concepts is-a 408102007.
initial_application: Commit 534313123abc479f1c95a22956d9992582f9743c, whose subject includes 8066, changed source/medication/valueset-medication-package-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT 284009009, route-of-administration value, to 408102007. No prior combined-branch Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-8066 was present before this audit.
additional_context: The current build still has Medication active in source/fhir.ini, but current source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml represents package quantity using Medication.packageSize and child elements; Medication.package.container is absent. Later history also matters: FHIR-12347 changed the then-current container binding to a local EDQM-derived code list in 2017, and GF #13879 later removed Medication.package.container. A residual valueset-medication-package-form-codes.xml file still contains the FHIR-8066-era 408102007 compose, but current Medication source no longer references the obsolete element or binding.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical issue was applied, then superseded by later Medication binding/model changes, so editing current Medication source for FHIR-8066 would add unrelated cleanup rather than fix a current specification error.
